title: Compute economics matrix: occupancy-aware throughput & cost-per-token harness for A10/L4/A100/H100
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a reproducible benchmarking harness that measures GPU-occupancy-aware tokens/sec, p95/p99 latencies, and cost-per-effective-token across A10, L4, A100, and H100. The goal is to produce a compute x workload matrix that normalizes for tokenizer overhead, KV cache hit-rate, and amortized context length so teams can compare unit economics for production workloads and detect regressions automatically.
background: Existing hw matrix reports focus on raw tokens/sec and per-shape latency but omit occupancy (GPU SM utilization / memory pressure) and tokenizer amortization, which skews cost-per-token when comparing different sequence distributions. We also lack a robust regression-detection pipeline that tolerates workload variance (mixed lengths, streaming vs non-streaming) and surfaces meaningful SLO breaches across model variants.
scope: Deliver a CLI-driven harness and CI job that: (1) runs synthetic and replayed request mixes across A10/L4/A100/H100 nodes, (2) computes occupancy-normalized throughput and cost metrics, (3) reports p50/p95/p99 and throughput distributions, (4) publishes artifacts to the benchmarking dashboard and triggers regression alerts when shifts exceed configurable thresholds.
out_of_scope: Implementing per-customer billing changes, running exhaustive model zoo sweeps, or automating hardware procurement decisions.
success_criteria: A repeatable run produces a matrix CSV with columns: gpu_type, model, batch_strategy, avg_tokens_per_req, kw_cache_hit_rate, occupancy_pct, tokens_per_sec_eff, cost_per_effective_token_usd, p95_latency_ms, p99_latency_ms
Integrate harness with perf-ci so nightly runs generate diffs and a regression flag if tokens_per_sec_eff drops >7% with p95 increase >10%
Dashboard tile shows per-GPU amortized cost for three representative workloads (short-chat, medium-infer, long-context-analytic)
Artifacts (raw traces, token histograms, occupancy traces) are uploaded to the benchmarks S3 path and linked in run metadata
metrics: tokens_per_second_raw: total tokens emitted / wall-clock serving seconds
occupancy_pct: 0-100 GPU SM occupancy averaged over run (sample rate 100Hz)
test_plan: 1) Define three canonical workloads: short-chat (mean len 40 tokens), medium-infer (mean len 256 tokens), long-context-analytic (mean len 2048 tokens). 2) For each GPU type (A10, L4, A100, H100) run: - cold-start single-request profile - steady-state 1-256 concurrency sweep - KV-cache warm vs cold runs - mixed-length zipf workload replay from production traces. 3) Capture SM occupancy, kernel timelines, memory pressure, token/time series, and tracer spans. 4) Validate metrics against golden-run tolerances and upload artifacts to benchmarks S3. 5) CI job diff with previous nightly and alert on regression thresholds.

notes_and_tradeoffs: We intentionally include tokenizer overhead to avoid overestimating GPU efficiency for small requests. Occupancy sampling adds noise; we'll use 95% bootstrap CI and require multiple runs (n>=3) per cell. Cost model will be region-agnostic initially (use us-west-2 prices) and later extended. We avoid per-model micro-optimizations in this ticket; the harness reports signals for runtime/compilation teams to act upon.
regression_detection_plan: Use a two-stage detection: (1) statistical guardrail: compute percent change vs golden-run with bootstrap confidence intervals; (2) alarm logic: if tokens_per_second_effective drops >7% AND p95 latency increases >10% AND change persists for 3 consecutive nightly runs, mark 'regression' and open ENG ticket automatically with artifacts. We will also compute EWMA over a 7-day window to suppress noisy single-run blips. Alerts to #perf-alerts with run link and top-3 diagnostic traces.

validation_steps: Run baseline on isolated hosts with no other workloads and confirm occupancy_pct within expected band (A10: 45-70, L4: 30-55, A100: 60-85, H100: 70-92)
Verify tokenizer probe reports <5% variance across repeated runs for medium-infer workload
Confirm cost_per_effective_token computed matches manual spreadsheet for at least one example cell
Trigger synthetic regression by throttling kernel on A100 and verify CI opens regression ticket
